seo.title: Haircut Styles in Carlsbad, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Fades, tapers, mullets, crops and more, cut in Carlsbad, NM. Real photos of every style, what to ask for and which service to book on Booksy.

photo_alt.cut-high-skin-fade-full-beard: High skin fade under a short buzzed top, a razor line above the ear and a full, squared beard

paragraphs: Every cut in this library is shown with real photos from Divinely Faded in Carlsbad. Open a style to see what it is, who it suits, how to keep it sharp and which Booksy service to choose.
Not sure what your cut is called? Bring a picture. Every Essential Haircut is tailored to you, so a photo of the look you want is the fastest place to start.

items.title: Skin Fade
items.body: Bare skin at the sides and back, blending into whatever length stays on top.

items.title: Low Taper Fade
items.body: Only the sideburns and nape come down. The mid taper lives here too.

items.title: Burst Fade
items.body: A semicircle of skin around the ear, with fullness kept at the back.

items.title: Modern Mullet
items.body: Tight faded sides and real length in back, burst fade mullet included.

items.title: Textured Fringe
items.body: Worn forward onto the forehead with choppy ends and tapered sides.

items.title: Buzz Cut
items.body: One short length all over. Crew cuts and the high and tight, too.

items.title: Slick Back
items.body: Length on top combed back off the face, over a taper or a fade.

items.title: Curly Top Fade
items.body: Natural curls up top, faded sides so the texture stands out.

items.title: Hard Part
items.body: A razor-cut part that holds its line without a comb.

items.title: Textured Crop
items.body: A short, broken-up top brought forward into a fringe over tight sides.

blocks.heading: Low, mid, high.
blocks.lead: The one choice every fade shares.
paragraphs: Most of these styles start with a fade, and the height is where it begins on the side of your head. Low starts near the ear, mid around the temple, high close to the crown. A drop fade dips down behind the ear toward the nape. Tell me the height when you sit down and the rest follows.

tim_questions: Photo allocation: cut-high-skin-fade-full-beard was assigned to the textured crop page, but it shows a buzzed top with a high skin fade, not a crop, so it is used on the styles hub instead.
